answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the dune of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The nadir holds work receipts rather than names, so the voyage of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
